rationale: Louan's deep learning work on clinical neuroimaging (fMRI segmentation, lesion detection with Swin UNETRs) and Kaarel's track record shipping computer vision and ML matching systems at scale represent a strong skill complement—Louan brings domain expertise in medical imaging pipelines while Kaarel excels at rapid prototyping and production ML. Both are Python/PyTorch practitioners in San Francisco, and Kaarel's conviction around moving fast to ship what larger companies haven't could accelerate Louan's applied neuroimaging work into a real product or startup.
intro_message: Louan, meet Kaarel Kaarelson — a founding ML engineer at Known.com who ships computer vision and matching systems at exceptional speed, and could help you productionize your fMRI and neuroimaging segmentation pipelines.
